name: panda_pick_and_place_mjwarp_dense_v0_large_vector_wall_clock
description: MuJoCo/MJWarp Menagerie Panda pick-and-place benchmark with a fixed large-vector wall-clock training window.
notes: Use on an NVIDIA/CUDA host with mujoco_warp installed.
The normal Gymnasium eval path stays CPU MuJoCo for deterministic parity while training collection can use the MJWarp vector backend.
Fixed eval success requires lift-before-place, so sliding the cube to the target does not solve the task.
